description: This file defines the UserUnlockedReceiver class, a BroadcastReceiver that listens for the user unlock event and triggers a callback when the device is unlocked.

classes.name: UserUnlockedReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for the user unlocked event and executes a callback when triggered.

methods.name: UserUnlockedReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with a callback to execute upon user unlock.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the broadcast event; if the intent action indicates user unlocked, logs the event and executes the callback.

methods.name: createIntentFilter
methods.description: Creates and returns an IntentFilter for the user unlocked action, requiring API level N or higher.
